releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.7 - Intelligent Ad Skipping & Autonomous Episode Unlocking
releaseNotes:
* Strict Pocket FM Target Lockdown: Scoped strictly to PocketFM (com.radio.pocketfm); all other streaming audio apps (Spotify, Audible, Kuku FM, Wynk) are bypassed
* Manual-Only Activation: Opening PocketFM never auto-starts unsolicited; engine remains idle until explicitly started by user via Dashboard or Floating Bubble
* Spatial Component Decomposition: Screen perception split into isolated components (TopLeft, TopRight, BottomLeft, BottomRight, CenterModal)
* Region-Tagged Telemetry: Diagnostics emit tagged spatial events ([SPATIAL:TOP_LEFT], [SPATIAL:TOP_RIGHT], etc.) for isolated debugging and zero-regression maintenance
* Full Test Suite: All 302 unit tests verified and passing (v1.0.7 Build 8)
